description: This file defines the 'RevokeAuthenticationEvents' class, which extends CookieAuthenticationEvents to handle the validation of authentication principal, checking for revoked sessions via an in-memory cache, and signing out users if their access has been revoked.

classes.name: RevokeAuthenticationEvents
classes.description: Custom authentication event handler for revoking user authentication based on cache entries.

methods.name: ValidatePrincipal
methods.description: Overrides the base method to validate the user's principal, checking if their session has been revoked and signing them out if so.
